components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary high-contrast button with tactile block shadow and physical press response.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4F46E5; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Geist', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #18181B; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #18181B; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338CA; transform: translate(-1px, -1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #18181B; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Clean neutral surface button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #18181B; font-family: 'Geist', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #18181B; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #18181B; transform: translate(-1px, -1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); }

components.name: Color Input Field

components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #18181B; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4F46E5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.35); }

narrative.overview:
Palettea blends modern minimalist utility (80%) with restrained soft neobrutalist tactile accents (20%). It treats color not as decorative wallpaper, but as living experimental material. Surfaces remain quiet, neutral, and unembellished so that active palettes and swatches command the visitor's focus without competing interface noise.

Tactile confidence manifests through crisp 1px borders, subtle solid 2px offset drop shadows (2px 2px 0px #18181B), and physical click depressions.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral Canvas, Vivid Content: Clean warm white (#FAF9F6) and deep slate (#18181B) backdrops let swatches lead.
Tactile Feedback: 2px offset block shadows on buttons and cards that depress by 1px on click.
Strict Monospace Data: Code values (HEX, RGB, HSL, ratios) always render in JetBrains Mono for instant scanning.
WCAG 2.2 Compliant: Swatch labels and overlays dynamically calculate contrast to guarantee readability.

rules.name: The Swatch Hero Rule
rules.body: Interface chrome must never use saturated decorative background colors. The accent color is reserved strictly for interactive affordances and key status indicators. Color swatches are the sole heroes of the viewport.

rules.name: The Code Integrity Rule
rules.body: Every color value (HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK), contrast ratio, and WCAG rating must strictly render in JetBrains Mono. Numbers must never shift width across state changes.

rules.name: The Tactile Click Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements with offset shadows must physically translate translate(-1px, -1px) on hover and translate(1px, 1px) on active press, reducing the perceived shadow depth to simulate physical tactile engagement.

dos: Do maintain high contrast between text overlays and active color swatches using relative luminance calculations.
Do preserve the tactile 2px offset shadow and 1px physical translation on interactive buttons.
Do format all color codes and numerical outputs in JetBrains Mono with quick-copy affordances.
Do ensure dark mode uses intentional zinc/slate tones rather than pure inverted blacks.
donts: Don't use diffuse fuzzy drop shadows, frosted glassmorphism, or decorative colored gradients on chrome surfaces.
Don't use emoji as user interface icons; use tree-shaken Lucide icons exclusively.
Don't let decorative accents overpower color swatches on screen.
Don't trigger destructive palette deletions without explicit confirmation dialogs.
